markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
The conformal set, second model and all 5 similar cases agree; flagged tier 2 for an invasive top class. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu <1% | One dominant class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.997 / 78th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce gland/tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low tubule score; concept model links this to invasion · Weak [F3]
- **Scarce benign stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Little benign background; concept-model association only · Validated [F4]
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; concept-model association · Validated
- **Nuclear size** (regions 2, 6, 7) · context · Mean 45 µm² (0th percentile); size variation 92nd percentile · Measured [F7]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses is Unreliable (0/20) [F2].

## Could be wrong if
- Mitosis (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) concepts failed spot checks, so those cues should not be relied on.
- Cell measurements cover only regions 2, 6 and 7; nuclear size at the 0th percentile is unexplained.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8** — confirm sparse tubules and benign stroma; look for infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 2, 6, 7** — compare the small nuclei and size variation with the measurements.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 10** — look for mitoses directly; the mitosis score failed its spot check.
